test.title: Null-safety: cascades, null-assertion access and ??=
test.source-generated:
<<<< [SOURCES_BEGIN] >>>>
<<<< NAMESPACE="" >>>>
<<<< CODE_UNIT_START="/test" >>>>
class Box {

  int n = 0;

  void add(int x) {
    n = n + x;
  }

  int cascadeSum(int a, int c) {
    Box bx = Box();
    bx..add(a)..add(c);
    return bx.n;
  }

  int forced(int a) {
    Box? bx = Box();
    bx!.add(a);
    return bx.n;
  }

  int orElse(int? a, int d) {
    int? v = a;
    v ??= d;
    return v;
  }

}
<<<< CODE_UNIT_END="/test" >>>>
